title: RE-PIN boot check on native4b, frontend on (agent slot, hidden desktop OK, NOT timing): Agent 4 task #12, REPIN.md section 3(a). One run: b0 on build/agent2/native4b-bin
notes: Written 2026-11-22 ~20:15 (Agent 4, task #12). native3_boot_check.py group A needs the effective native_settings_frontend=true, and every arm of matrix-repin-native4b.json runs with it false, so the boot check gets this 1-run matrix. Run it after REPIN.md step 3 (the pin record), in Agent 3's S4b queue: bench\agent8\run\run-matrix.ps1 -Matrix build\agent4\repin\matrix-repin-native4b-boot.json -NoPrompt -OutDir build\agent3\runs\repin-boot-<stamp> (always pass -OutDir: without it the output goes to build\agent8\matrix and trips Agent 1's HOLD). 1 run, about 4 min. Functional only (hidden desktop OK).

Then: python bench\agent7\native3_boot_check.py build\agent3\runs\repin-boot-<stamp>\runs\<HHMM>-b0-r1 --bin-dir build\agent2\native4b-bin. Pass: exit 0 (no FAIL in A, B or C) plus D's identity lines (D is info-only and never FAILs on its own; REPIN.md 3a). A: frontend true (from the run's command line). B: no throw/fatal line, a present line after 'Native write tracking', run.json OK, no dumps, >= 600 native-frames.csv rows. C: bilinear present. D: a PASS line 'native GPU fingerprint: MANIFEST 9b40acbbef4c57b3, game.log 9b40acbbef4c57b3' (a missing line is a fail: the check skips it when either side is missing), PASS on the fix (a) MANIFEST rows (settings_registry.cpp -> 4EC71328 or 8BA19C5F, settings_preferences.cpp -> 9CBE6DBF), and VERDICT D=PASS with no WARN; send any other D WARN to Agent 4.
The check reads <run>\native-frames.csv, which this arm's env sets. harness/run-game.ps1 writes frames.csv instead, so a run-game.ps1 boot would fail groups B and C (no native rows): use this matrix.

Until native4b-bin has a MANIFEST.txt, run-matrix skips the arm. On a fail, send the run dir and the check output to Agent 4 and Agent 2; the pin stays on native4 (5e3ff55de10f4f64) and native4b-bin is parked.

arms.note: native4b (S4b + S4c, every switch OFF), frontend on (NativeSettingsRuntime built), default serial path. Expected fingerprint 9b40acbbef4c57b3
